notes: Printer Bot 3.1.1 fixes one case of the Catbox albums of 3.1.0: an album whose first file is a video, with pictures after it, printed its first picture. It now prints the link as text, as an album of only a video already did, because only the first item of an album may print. Everything else is as in 3.1.0. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.1.1 on GitHub.
